messages.author: a59c03f035656bc1
messages.subject: Weird behavior of primitive functions
parts:
Hi folks,

My question might be kind of silly, but I am wondering how the generated sources are produced. I found some primitive functions having different behaviors from GNU R, and they are located in generated sources. Is there a brief illustration showing how to fix such problems?

Thanks,

Max

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Weird behavior of primitive functions
parts:
Hi Max,
There's a write up here that might help:
http://www.renjin.org/documentation/contributor-guide.html

Basicall the primitives are generated from the annotations, so for example if you look at the multiply primitive ("*"), it's defined in Ops.java as:


@Deferrable
@Builtin("*")
@DataParallel(PreserveAttributeStyle.ALL)
public static double multiply(double x, double y) {
  return x * y;
}

and so if you wanted to add an argument, you could do that here and the wrapper generators will update accordingly.

What kind of differences are you seeing?

Best,
Alex
